Sam: Quick kickoff for GCP marketplace onboarding (EU region). Target: publish a light SKU with 14-day trial + SSO via SAML. Need legal addendum, SBOM, and a GCP deployment snippet.

Ivy: For GCP we should do container + Deployment Manager template. I can produce the Terraform snippet too.

Noah: Security checklist: container SBOM, vulnerability scan <48h, init script audit, and an allowlist for telemetry endpoints. Also confirm whether BYOK for KMS is required.

Priya: Contracts: we'll use base EULA + short EU data-residency addendum. I'll post drafts by Tue. Also marketing needs a short blurb for the listing.

Ivy: Image size constraint: keep compressed image <1.5GB. We'll lazy-pull weights at first boot to stay under limit.

marketplace-bot: Reminder: upload assets 72h before submission window. Validation may take up to 5 business days.

Sam: Timeline: Mon EOD  contracts draft; Tue AM  SBOM + scans; Tue noon  deployment snippets; Wed 09:00 PT  upload. Reconvene Tue 16:00 PT to confirm.

Noah: I'll own SBOM + scan links. Ivy will share Terraform. Priya will share legal addenda. Thanks.
